logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 1's cliffhanger. Gerald has turned away from Juliana at the altar, leaving her devastated before the entire aristocratic congregation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cruel, Derisive)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: You are far too plain...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Off-screen) (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: ...far too silent...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Conceited)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Pleading)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Gerald... Look at me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Betrayed)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You gave me your word before both our families.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Indifferent, Unapologetic)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Shattered, Disbelieving)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Resolute, Harsh)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Vulnerable, Begging)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Father...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Choked with Tears)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Stern, Cold)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Severely, Harsh)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Do not disgrace us further.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Crushed)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You won't even look at me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen) (Scornful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: That plain, old-fashioned gown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Taunting, Giggling)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen) (Snide)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: And that quiet little face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Conceited, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Gerald needs a real lady...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Off-screen) (Vicious)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

segments.label: OFF-SCREEN VOICE (Cold, Scolding)
segments.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
segments.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

segments.label: OFF-SCREEN VOICE (Dismissive, Condescending)
segments.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
segments.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Impatient, Commanding)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Dignity?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.
